basic_identification.full_title: Unidirectional Non-Woven Semi-Cured Glass Fibre Tape — Specification (एकदिशीय गैर-बुना अर्ध-पका हुआ ग्लास फाइबर टेप — विशिष्टि)
basic_identification.sector_category: Electrotechnical / Solid Electrical Insulating Materials (approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council and finalized by the Solid Electrical Insulating Materials Sectional Committee, ET 02, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Solid Electrical Insulating Materials Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the quality, material, constructional, and performance-testing specifications for unidirectional non-woven glass fabric tape consisting of parallel twisted glass yarns designed to bandage armatures of rotating machines and transformer coils to hold assembly windings securely in position.

version_status_and_amendments.supersedes: None (Developed as a new dedicated specification for resin-impregnated glass banding tapes)

cross_referenced_standards_top_20.title: Thermal evaluation and classification of electrical insulation
cross_referenced_standards_top_20.relevance: Used to align the thermal class index of the synthetic resin binder with the target electrical machine rating.

cross_referenced_standards_top_20.title: Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)
cross_referenced_standards_top_20.relevance: Standardises the mathematical rounding of evaluated parameters and test results to determine code compliance.

allied_standards.title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Rotor and stator winding overhangs of submersible pump motors operate completely submersed in water, requiring high-tensile glass fiber bandaging tapes to secure connections under dynamic operational forces.

allied_standards.title: Insulating Varnishes Containing Solvents — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Resin binders on glass tapes are cured alongside or treated with hot-curing impregnating varnishes during machine bakes, requiring high chemical compatibility.

allied_standards.title: Guide for Determining Compatibility Between Enamelled Winding Wire and Impregnating Compounds
allied_standards.relevance: Verifies that the resin binder used on the tape does not experience harmful chemical degradation or softening when in direct contact with enamelled wires.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice on Occupational Safety and Health Audit
allied_standards.relevance: Governs safety audits in high-temperature tape curing yards, chemical storage bays, and laboratory testing ovens.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for General Steel Construction
allied_standards.relevance: The master structural steel code in India, regulating support steelwork, crane structures, and machine mounting plates carrying heavy rotating machinery.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Material Specification (Electrotechnical Department / Solid Electrical Insulating Materials)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to obtain a valid BIS license to stamp or emboss the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' directly on the product rolls or boxes to certify dimensional, thermal, and metallurgical conformity.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, thickness tolerances, storage temperatures, and weight loss percentages must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
The tape must consist of parallel twisted glass yarns aligned in a unidirectional non-woven pattern to provide maximum longitudinal tensile strength.
The glass yarns must be constructed of continuous E-glass fibers containing not more than one percent of alkali calculated as sodium oxide.

The fiber tape must be impregnated with catalyzed thermosetting synthetic resins (such as acrylic, polyester, or epoxy compounds) and semi-cured to a suitable B-stage to ensure optimal flow and tack-free handling during winding.

Because the tape is semi-cured, storage temperature governs shelf life: 10°C storage provides 18 months of shelf life; 15°C storage provides 12 months; and 20°C storage provides 8 months. Normally, the manufacturing date must not be earlier than one month from dispatch.
Preferred nominal thicknesses are 0.3 or 0.33 mm. The measured thickness must not deviate from the nominal value by more than ± 0.05 mm.

Thickness is measured using a micrometer with 0.01 mm accuracy under 10 N/cm² pressure, on 5 rolls selected at random conditioned as per IS 196 (65 ± 2% RH and 27 ± 2 °C). Ten measurements are taken every 300 mm.

Three 1 m specimens are cut, weighed, and heated in an oven at a temperature 20°C higher than the designated thermal class of the tape for 400 hours ± 30 minutes, cooled in a desiccator, and reweighed. Weight loss must satisfy low, specified limits to ensure resin stability.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 15208 : 2002 (Reaffirmed 2022) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing quality requirements and testing methods for unidirectional non-woven glass fiber tapes impregnated with semi-cured thermosetting resins. Maintained under the Solid Electrical Insulating Materials Sectional Committee (ET 02), the standard unifies high-voltage armature bandaging, motor construction, and transformer coil insulation across the nation. It mandates low-alkali continuous E-glass fibers (containing not more than 1% alkali calculated as sodium oxide) and regulates critical temperature-controlled shelf life (ranging from 8 months at 20°C up to 18 months at 10°C) to protect the reactive flow properties of the semi-cured resin. The code enforces standard thickness ranges (0.30–0.33 mm) with a tight ±0.05 mm tolerance checked using precise micrometer setups, alongside rigorous thermal weight loss test limits (heating specimens 20°C above their thermal class limit for 400 hours) to ensure extreme mechanical integrity under high rotating centrifugal forces.
